tagline: Split one ASIC into multiple virtual miners with pool alternation
description:
SplitMiner is a Stratum proxy that accepts one or more ASIC connections
and splits them across virtual miners, each on its own pool or worker.
Each ASIC mines its own virtual miner, at that pool's difficulty.
Hashrate above the targets goes to OVERFLOW. The dashboard shows the
live flow from each ASIC, plus share tracking and CG-API per virtual miner.

First run:

1. Open the app — configure virtual miners (pool URL, worker, optional target)
2. Point your ASIC at `stratum+tcp://YOUR_HOST_IP:3333`
3. Watch shares and hashrate on the dashboard

Features:

- Split one miner into N virtual miners
- Optional per-VM targets in TH/s or % of total hashrate
- Excess above targets routes to OVERFLOW when enabled
- CG-API per VM (ports 4028+)
- Difficulty override for low-hashrate miners

Host ports **3333** and **4028–4030** must be free. If another stratum proxy
is already bound to 3333, the container will fail to start.
author: Carpathians

tips.before_install:
Requires free host ports **3333** (Stratum) and **4028–4030** (CG-API).
The dashboard is on port **8755**.

After install, point the ASIC at `stratum+tcp://YOUR_HOST_IP:3333`.

title: SplitMiner
release_note:
1.4.0

- Each ASIC mines its own virtual miner, so three machines can cover three pools
- ASIC difficulty follows the pool it is on, not the highest pool in the farm
- Uncovered virtual miners are filled before OVERFLOW
- Dashboard shows the live hashrate flow from each ASIC
- Shares are counted at the difficulty the ASIC actually mined
